extracted text: The paper discusses AA2219 aluminum alloy in two different temper conditions: T87 and T851. The T87 condition involves solution treatment at 807 K (534°C) for 1 hour + 7% stretching followed by aging at 436 K (163°C) for 24 hours. The T851 condition involves solution treatment at 807 K (534°C) for 1 hour + stress relieved by 3% stretching followed by aging at 436 K (163°C) for 24 hours. The alloy rings in T851 temper condition were processed through forging route with multiple re-heatings and had a quench delay of 87 seconds. The paper also mentions AA2319 filler wire used for welding.
property mapping:
AA = Aluminum Association alloy designation (AA2219, AA2319)
Temper = T87 (solution treatment + 7% stretching + artificial aging), T851 (solution treatment + 3% stretching + artificial aging)
UTS = Ultimate Tensile Strength (MPa)
YS = 0.2% Yield Strength (MPa)
Pct Elongation = Elongation percentage (%)
Elements (Cu, Mn, Zr, V, Ti, Fe, Si, Zn) = Weight percentage of elements
abbreviations:
L: Longitudinal direction
LT: Long Transverse direction
ST: Short Transverse direction
C: Circumferential direction
R: Radial direction
A: Axial direction
PP: Plate to plate weld
PR: Plate to Ring weld
FZ: Fusion Zone
BM: Base Metal
TIG: Tungsten Inert Gas (welding)
MP: Multi-pass welding
